meta.description_1l: Local durable collaboration router for Codex-led multi-agent workflows.
meta.description_short: Agent Collab is a machine-local CLI and MCP service backed by private SQLite state. Codex is the required execution harness; Grok and Claude Code are optional review providers. The service owns typed workflow execution, recovery, review barriers, provider health, and graph-linked telemetry.

architecture_fidelity.truth_model: evidence-ranked approximation; not a complete runtime call graph
architecture_fidelity.enrichment_model: final deterministic pass over production code evidence and first-party tests
architecture_fidelity.tool_orchestration_model: repo-c4-scan auto-runs ast-index and ast-code-graph when available

confidence_scale.high: direct first-party import or inheritance resolved to an existing file
confidence_scale.medium: unique first-party symbol reference resolved to an existing file
confidence_scale.low: heuristic relationship that needs human confirmation

blind_spots: plugin loading discovered only at runtime
remote service behavior outside this repository
generated or vendored code intentionally excluded

tool_orchestration.strategy: repo-c4-scan orchestrates ast-index and ast-code-graph as optional evidence providers

system.description: Machine-local collaboration service that coordinates durable Codex-led workflows through CLI and MCP entry points.

users.name: Local Operator
users.description: Configures, supervises, and audits collaboration workflows on the local machine

users.name: Coding Agent Client
users.description: Invokes the collaboration service through its CLI or MCP interface

system.top_boundary: Machine-local collaboration runtime, private state, and first-party code contained in this repository.

containers.name: Agent Collab
containers.description: Node.js CLI and MCP process that owns workflow orchestration, durable SQLite state, provider routing, review barriers, recovery, and telemetry.
responsibilities: Execute typed graph workflows with durable recovery and review barriers
Route Codex execution and optional Grok or Claude Code review providers according to health and policy
Persist workflow state, evidence, provider health, and graph-linked telemetry in private SQLite stores
Expose local operator and coding-agent entry points through CLI and MCP
